functions.name: Liquidity provision
functions.analogue: Equity into buyers of Nvidia systems.
functions.verdict_reason: Investees pair Nvidia money with Nvidia compute, but co-investors bought on equal terms.

evidence_for.text: Nvidia bought $10.0 billion of Anthropic stock; Anthropic buys Nvidia GPU compute from three clouds.
Nscale took Nvidia equity and notes despite going-concern doubt.

evidence_against.text: Google bought identical Anthropic shares on the same terms.
Intel, Synopsys and Nokia were well funded, with no linked purchases.

functions.name: Collateral support
functions.analogue: Guaranties that make GPU and data center debt bankable.
functions.verdict_reason: One borrower relies on Nvidia's guaranty, but that debt is not raised yet.

evidence_for.text: SB Energy says PORTS-Pike financing depends on Nvidia's guaranty because OpenAI is not investment grade.

evidence_against.text: No CoreWeave credit agreement read names the Nvidia order.
No PORTS-Pike debt is in place.

functions.name: Pricing of money
functions.analogue: Nvidia's entry sets counterparties' cost of capital.
functions.verdict_reason: No source ties a round price or loan spread to Nvidia.

evidence_against.text: Others led Nvidia's rounds: GIC and Coatue at Anthropic, ASML at Mistral.

functions.name: Lender of last resort
functions.analogue: Nvidia steps in when others will not lend.
functions.verdict_reason: Some backed firms show stress, but no rescue deal is sourced.

evidence_for.text: Nvidia backstops SharonAI, whose filing has a going-concern section.

evidence_against.text: Nvidia can end the CoreWeave order after a 90 day insolvency.
Intel raised $23.0 billion of equity; Anthropic held $95.6 billion of cash.

where_the_analogy_breaks: Nvidia cannot create money. Its contingent maximum is $112 billion, against shareholders' equity of $228,984 million and cash and marketable debt of $56,586 million at 26 July 2026. The OpenAI guaranty alone is capped at $105 billion, recoverable only from OpenAI, unsecured. Its support rests on its own cash flow, which depends on the same AI demand.
overall: Nvidia supplies equity and credit support that funds its customers' spending. It is a finite private balance sheet, not a price setter or rescuer.
